description: Translate text between languages using Nextcloud's configured translation provider. If called without text, returns the available languages. Translation runs as a Nextcloud AI task; if it takes longer than about 30 seconds, the task ID is returned for get_task_result.

fromLanguage.description: Source language code (e.g. 'en', 'de'). Omit to detect it.

text.description: Text to translate. Omit to list available languages.

name: translate_text
title: Translate Text
